description: DatabaseProvider is the Schema for the databaseproviders API.

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: DatabaseProviderSpec defines the desired state of DatabaseProvider.

defaultDatabase.description:
DefaultDatabase is the database claims use when they do not specify one.
For external providers, this also supplies the default database when the
admin Secret omits pg.database. When unset, the provider Secret (external)
or the built-in internal default database may still supply the value.

external.description:
External configures a provider pointing at an admin-managed instance.
Mutually exclusive with Internal.

capabilities.description:
Capabilities declares which lifecycle operations claims may perform
against this external provider.

items.description:
ExternalCapability declares which schema/database lifecycle operations an
external provider allows claims to perform.

connectionSecretRef.description:
ConnectionSecretRef points at a Secret holding admin-level connection
info, which may live in a different namespace than any claim (unlike
claim credential Secrets, which always live in the claim's own
namespace).

name.description: name is unique within a namespace to reference a secret resource.

namespace.description: namespace defines the space within which the secret name must be unique.

internal.description:
Internal configures a controller-owned instance. Mutually exclusive
with External.

extensions.description:
Extensions lists PostgreSQL extensions to make available inside the
internal instance. Cannot be changed after provider creation.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: extensions are immutable after provider creation

namespace.description:
Namespace overrides where the internal PostgreSQL resources are created.
The operator service account needs the Internal writer role bound there.
When unset, the operator namespace is used. Cannot be changed after creation.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: namespace is immutable after provider creation

resources.description:
Resources override the internal PostgreSQL container defaults. Unspecified
requests default to 500m CPU and 1Gi memory; limits default to 2 CPU and 4Gi memory.

claims.description:
Claims lists the names of resources, defined in spec.resourceClaims,
that are used by this container.

This field depends on the
DynamicResourceAllocation feature gate.

This field is immutable. It can only be set for containers.

items.description: ResourceClaim references one entry in PodSpec.ResourceClaims.

name.description:
Name must match the name of one entry in pod.spec.resourceClaims of
the Pod where this field is used. It makes that resource available
inside a container.

request.description:
Request is the name chosen for a request in the referenced claim.
If empty, everything from the claim is made available, otherwise
only the result of this request.

limits.description:
Limits describes the maximum amount of compute resources allowed.
More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/

requests.description:
Requests describes the minimum amount of compute resources required.
If Requests is omitted for a container, it defaults to Limits if that is explicitly specified,
otherwise to an implementation-defined value. Requests cannot exceed Limits.
More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/

size.description: Size is the requested PVC storage size. It can only increase after creation.

storageClassName.description:
StorageClassName is passed through to the PVC verbatim when set. It cannot
be changed after creation because the PVC is retained with its data.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: storageClassName is immutable after provider creation
storage.size must be greater than zero
storage.size can only increase after provider creation
storageClassName cannot be added or removed after provider creation

tls.description:
TLS enables TLS for the internal PostgreSQL instance. Presence of this
field opts into TLS; an empty object uses controller defaults.

certificate.description: Certificate customizes the server certificate request.

duration.description: Duration overrides the requested certificate lifetime.

renewBefore.description: RenewBefore overrides how long before expiry cert-manager renews.

secretName.description: SecretName overrides the cert-manager target Secret name.

issuerRef.description: IssuerRef overrides the default provider-scoped self-signed issuer.

group.description: Group defaults to cert-manager.io when omitted.

kind.description: Kind defaults to Issuer when omitted.

name.description: Name is the metadata.name of the referenced issuer.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: namespace cannot be added or removed after provider creation
extensions cannot be added or removed after provider creation

type.description: Type selects which of External/Internal below is populated.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: exactly one of external or internal must be set
spec.type must match the set provider type

status.description:
DatabaseProviderStatus defines the observed state of DatabaseProvider.
Its embedded common.Status provides Phase, Conditions, and
ObservedGeneration.

lastHeartbeatTime.description:
The last time we got an update on a given condition, this should not be set and is
present only for backward compatibility reasons

lastTransitionTime.description:
lastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.
This should be when the underlying condition changed.
If that is not known, then using the time when the API field changed is acceptable.

message.description: message is a human-readable message indicating details about the transition.

observedGeneration.description:
observedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon.
For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions[x].observedGeneration
is 9, the condition is out of date with respect to the current state of the instance.

reason.description:
reason contains a programmatic identifier indicating the reason for the condition's last transition.
The value should be a CamelCase string.

severity.description:
Severity with which to treat failures of this type of condition.
When this is not specified, it defaults to Error.

status.description: status of the condition, one of True, False, Unknown.

type.description: type of condition in CamelCase or in foo.example.com/CamelCase.

connection.description: Connection is the non-secret connection surface for the provider.

observedGeneration.description: The generation observed by the resource controller.

releases.description: Releases is the list of deployed component releases.

items.description: ComponentRelease describes a single software component's release metadata.

name.description: Name is the component name, used as the merge key in lists.

repoUrl.description: RepoURL is the source repository URL for this component release.

version.description: Version is the semantic version of the component.

serverVersion.description: ServerVersion is the detected PostgreSQL server version. It does not gate binding.

tls.description: TLS reports the resolved TLS state for the provider.

certificateName.description: CertificateName is the cert-manager Certificate name, when managed.

enabled.description: Enabled reflects whether TLS is configured for this provider.

issuerRef.description: IssuerRef identifies the issuer used for the current certificate flow.

group.description: Group defaults to cert-manager.io when omitted.

kind.description: Kind defaults to Issuer when omitted.

name.description: Name is the metadata.name of the referenced issuer.

namespace.description: Namespace is where the TLS resources for this provider live.

ready.description:
Ready reports whether the provider's TLS contract is fully configured and
consumable.

secretName.description: SecretName is the Secret name holding the server certificate material.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: Internal provider metadata.name must be a DNS-1035 label of at most 50 characters so derived ServiceAccount and RoleBinding names stay within the 63-character Kubernetes limit
